new.name: Adult Damsel
new.description: A floating adult damselfly with a light blue foam body, white hackle-point wings, knotted pheasant tail legs and a blue badger hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it near reeds and lily pads on bright summer days; trout and bass jump for it.
steps: Tie a thin foam strip as an extended abdomen and segment it with thread.
Tie in the hackle-point wings flat and spent on each side.
Add knotted pheasant tail legs and dub a blue thorax.
Wind the hackle, pull the foam cover over the thorax and finish.

new.name: Alexandra
new.description: A flashy old lake fly with a silver body, a black hackle and a peacock sword wing with red slips on the sides.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on the point of a team of wet flies in lakes, or strip it for brook trout.
mats: Thin slips of red goose or duck
steps: Tie in a short red slip as the tail and the rib.
Wind the silver body and rib it.
Tie in a black beard hackle.
Tie a peacock sword wing with thin red slips on each side.

new.name: Parachute Red Ant
new.description: A small parachute ant with an orange or red thread abdomen, a peacock quill rib, a fiery brown hackle and a white yarn post for visibility.
new.fishing_tips: Drift it under overhanging trees on warm days.
steps: Tie in a white yarn post at the thorax.
Build a rounded thread abdomen and rib it with quill.
Dub the thorax around the post.
Wind the hackle parachute style and finish.

new.name: Polliwog Jig Leech
new.description: A small articulated jig leech with a polliwog tail on a micro jig shank and a tungsten bead, sized for trout and panfish.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under an indicator or on a slow strip; the tail swims on the drop.
steps: Slide the bead on the jig shank and start the thread.
Tie in the polliwog tail and dub an Ice Dub body.
Join the shank to the hook with a short loop.
Build a small hot-spot collar and cement the wraps.

new.name: Articulated Sparkle Minnow
new.description: A two-hook version of the Sparkle Minnow with Sparkle Minnow brush bodies, a marabou tail and a fish mask head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip and pause for bass and big trout.
steps: Tie a marabou tail on the rear hook and wrap a Sparkle Minnow brush body.
Join it to the front hook with wire.
Wrap a second brush body on the front hook.
Fit the fish mask, add eyes and coat with resin.

new.name: Barracuda Tube Fly
new.description: A long, thin barracuda fly made from net tubing over wire with two hooks, bucktail, rainbow Flashabou and stick-on eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Rip it fast across the flats; barracuda chase speed.
mats: Rainbow Flashabou and red Krystal Flash
steps: Join two hooks with wire.
Slide the net tubing over the wire and tie it down at both ends.
Add a slim bucktail and flash wing at the front.
Stick on eyes and coat the head with UV resin.

new.name: Lucky B
new.description: A yellow-jacket or bee imitation with an extended foam butt, barred legs, a black thorax and a macrame yarn wing.
new.fishing_tips: Drift it near banks in late summer when wasps and bees fall in.
steps: Build an extended foam butt on a tippet connector.
Tie it to the hook and add the foam body.
Tie in the legs and dub a black thorax.
Add a short yarn wing and finish.

new.name: Little Black Stonefly Nymph
new.description: A slim black stonefly nymph with stretch tubing abdomen, centipede leg antennae and legs, a pheasant tail wing case and a hare's mask thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in winter and early spring when little black stones hatch.
steps: Tie in centipede leg antennae and tails.
Wrap a segmented tubing abdomen.
Tie in the wing case and legs.
Dub the thorax, pull the wing case over and finish.

new.name: Blue Zulu
new.description: A loch-style palmered wet fly with a red wool tail, black seal's fur body, black body hackle and a teal-blue front hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on the top dropper in a wave on lakes.
steps: Tie in the red wool tail.
Dub a black body and palmer the body hackle.
Rib the body with silver tinsel.
Wind the blue front hackle.

new.name: Bulkhead Deceiver
new.description: A predator Deceiver with a reverse-tied bucktail bulkhead head that pushes water, using two lengths of bucktail and Hedron Polar Flash.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for pike, musky and stripers on long strips with pauses.
steps: Tie long bucktail and flash at the rear as the tail.
Tie shorter bucktail bunches forward along the shank.
Reverse-tie bucktail at the front and fold it back to form the bulkhead head.
Add eyes and finish.

new.name: McPhail Caddis Emerger
new.description: A caddis emerger or dry on a grub hook with a yellow yarn body, scud-back cover, roe deer wing, partridge legs and bronze mallard antennae.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film during evening caddis hatches.
steps: Tie in the scud back and wrap a yarn body around the bend.
Pull the back over and rib it.
Tie in the roe deer wing and partridge legs.
Add burnt nylon eyes and mallard antennae.

new.name: Karl the Caddis Pupa
new.description: A simple caddis pupa with a chartreuse rabbit dubbing abdomen, a hare's mask collar and a slotted tungsten bead.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep and let it swing up at the end of the drift.
mats: Brown and black hare's mask dubbing
steps: Slide on the bead and start the thread.
Dub a smooth chartreuse abdomen.
Dub a spiky hare's mask collar.
Pick out the collar and whip finish.

new.name: Fisherman's Curse
new.description: A tiny Caenis dun with a black tail, white CDC body, a grey yarn thorax cover and a CDC wing, for the hatch anglers call the fisherman's curse.
new.fishing_tips: Use it during dense Caenis hatches at dawn on still water.
steps: Tie in a few black tail fibres.
Wrap a white CDC body.
Tie in the CDC wing and grey yarn cover.
Build a thread thorax, pull the cover over and varnish.

new.name: Barry's Carp Bitter
new.description: A carp fly with bead chain eyes, a grizzly marabou tail, sili legs, an angora goat body and a soft hackle collar, after Bonefish Bitters.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it in front of feeding carp and twitch it once.
mats: Cream and orange angora goat dubbing
Tan or brown grizzly soft hackle
steps: Tie on bead chain eyes so the fly rides hook up.
Tie in a marabou tail with legs at the bend.
Dub a goat body.
Wind a soft hackle collar and finish.

new.name: CDC Jig Head Nymph
new.description: A euro nymph on a jig hook with a Coq de Leon tail, red wire rib, a pink CDC and hare body, a small CDC hackle and a UV dub thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a tight line through riffles.
mats: Pink CDC fibres mixed with hare's mask
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in the tail.
Dub the body and rib it.
Wind one turn of CDC.
Dub the thorax and finish.

new.name: Claret Dabbler
new.description: An Irish-style loch fly with a claret seal's fur body, pearl and red rib, a claret badger hackle and a bronze mallard cloak.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on the top dropper in a ripple.
mats: Medium pearl and small red wire
steps: Tie a short tag and mallard tail.
Dub the body, palmer the hackle and rib it.
Add a mallard throat.
Tie a mallard cloak wing around the top half.

new.name: Foxee Red Clouser
new.description: A small Clouser in tan arctic fox with gold speckled flash and red dumbbell eyes, a top smallmouth fly.
new.fishing_tips: Strip and hop it along riffles and drop-offs.
mats: Gold speckled Flashabou and brown Krystal Flash
steps: Tie the dumbbell eyes a third back from the eye.
Tie a sparse fox tuft behind and in front of the eyes.
Add the flash.
Tie another fox tuft on top and finish.

new.name: Crane Fly Larva
new.description: A plump crane fly larva of oyster Shetland wool over lead, tied with pink thread for a hint of colour.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it near the bottom after rain.
steps: Wrap lead wire on the shank.
Tie in the wool at the bend.
Wrap a fat, slightly tapered body.
Pick out the fibres and finish.

new.name: Swimming Crane Fly Larva
new.description: A crane fly larva on a jig hook with a trimmed rabbit strip body that wiggles, a black tungsten bead and a mono tail guard.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under an indicator after high water.
mats: Natural brown rabbit zonker strip, trimmed underneath
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in a mono tail guard.
Tie in the rabbit strip along the shank.
Trim the hair on the bottom.
Finish behind the bead.

new.name: Don Brown Crawdad
new.description: An old-school crayfish with red squirrel claws, a brown yarn body, palmered brown hackle and a turkey shellback.
new.fishing_tips: Crawl it slowly along rocky bottoms for bass and trout.
steps: Tie in a red squirrel tuft at the bend as claws.
Tie in the shellback, hackle and yarn.
Wrap the body and palmer the hackle.
Pull the shellback over and tie off.

new.name: Davie's Black Cricket
new.description: A realistic black cricket with biot tails, stretchy foam body and back, biot legs, a black hackle and pheasant tail horns.
new.fishing_tips: Plop it near grassy banks in late summer.
mats: Black turkey biots and black cock hackle
steps: Tie in biot tails and the foam.
Dub the body and pull the foam over.
Add biot legs and wind the hackle.
Dub the head and add the horns.

new.name: Fiery Brown Dabbler
new.description: A dabbler with a fiery brown seal's fur body, gold rib, an orange guinea throat and a bronze mallard cloak.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on the top dropper on lakes.
mats: Bronze mallard and fiery brown hackle fibres
Flat gold tinsel and gold wire
steps: Tie in the tail and ribs.
Dub the body and palmer the hackle.
Rib it and add the guinea throat.
Tie the mallard cloak around the top.

new.name: Foam Daddy Long Legs
new.description: A crane fly with a thin tan foam body, knotted pheasant tail legs, cree hackle-tip wings and a brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on lakes in late summer when daddies blow onto the water.
steps: Tie in a foam strip as the body and thorax cover.
Add knotted legs trailing back.
Tie in hackle-tip wings spent.
Wind the hackle and pull the foam over.

new.name: Ditch Pickle
new.description: An articulated pike and bass streamer with marabou, shimmer fringe, magnum rabbit wings, schlappen, Senyo brushes and a fish mask head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it with long pulls and pauses.
mats: Palmered rabbit strip and Senyo Aqua Veil
steps: Tie the rear hook: marabou, flash, rabbit wing, schlappen and brush.
Join it to the front hook.
Palmer marabou and rabbit on the front hook with Aqua Veil.
Fit the fish mask and finish.

new.name: Early Black Stonefly Nymph
new.description: A small black stonefly nymph with stretch tubing, centipede legs, a brown pheasant tail wing case and possum thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in late winter.
steps: Tie in tails and antennae.
Wrap the tubing abdomen.
Tie in the wing case and legs.
Dub the thorax and pull the wing case over.

new.name: Epoxy Ant
new.description: A durable ant with a body of thread coated in epoxy and a dry fly hackle for legs.
new.fishing_tips: Drift it near banks in summer.
steps: Build two thread humps, larger at the rear.
Coat them with epoxy and let it cure.
Wind a dry fly hackle between the humps.
Whip finish at the eye.

new.name: Fiery Brown Bumble
new.description: An Irish bumble with a red tag, tippet tail, fiery brown seal's fur body and palmered hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a bob fly on lakes.
steps: Tie the tag and tail.
Dub the body and palmer the hackle.
Rib it.
Wind the front hackle.

new.name: Cinnamon Flying Ant
new.description: A cinnamon flying ant with an orange foam body, white poly wings and a brown hackle trimmed flat underneath.
new.fishing_tips: Use it during late summer ant falls.
steps: Tie in the foam to form the rear hump.
Tie in the poly wing.
Wind the hackle and trim it flat underneath.
Form the front hump and finish.

new.name: G&H Sedge
new.description: Davie McPhail's grannom version of the G&H Sedge, with a green egg sack, a clipped roe deer body and wing and a ginger hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Skate it across lakes or rivers during sedge hatches.
mats: Light natural roe deer, spun and trimmed
steps: Tie in the egg sack.
Spin roe deer along the shank.
Trim to a sedge shape.
Wind the hackle.

new.name: Golden Olive Bumble
new.description: A golden olive bumble with a crest tail, olive seal's fur body, palmered golden yellow hackle and a blue jay front hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on the top dropper.
mats: Two barred ginger dyed golden yellow
steps: Tie in the crest tail.
Dub the body and palmer the hackles.
Rib it.
Wind the blue jay front hackle and finish with red thread.

new.name: CDC Grannom
new.description: A grannom dry with a green foam egg sack, a CDC body and a mixed CDC and roe deer wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to risers in early spring.
mats: Natural and cinnamon CDC with roe deer
steps: Tie in a small green foam egg sack at the bend.
Dub a CDC body.
Tie in a mixed CDC and roe deer wing.
Dub the thorax and finish.

new.name: Grouse and Claret
new.description: A classic lake wet fly with a hot orange tippet tail, claret seal's fur body and a rolled grouse wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in a team of wet flies.
steps: Tie in the tail and rib.
Dub the body and rib it.
Add a black hen hackle.
Tie a rolled grouse wing.

new.name: Mop Grub
new.description: A short chartreuse mop grub with a brass bead and straggle legs.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it or twitch it under an indicator.
steps: Slide on the bead and start the thread.
Glue a short mop piece to the shank.
Tie in straggle legs at the thorax.
Coat the wraps with thin UV resin.

new.name: Haystack Emerger
new.description: An emerger with a pearl rib, olive SLF body and thorax and a coastal deer hair wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film during hatches.
steps: Tie in the pearl rib and dub a slim olive body.
Rib the body.
Tie in a short coastal deer hair wing.
Dub an olive thorax around the base of the wing.

new.name: Half-Hog Heather Fly
new.description: A Bibio or heather fly with a pearl rib, black seal's fur body, black and red deer hair wing and knotted legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on lakes when the heather flies fall.
steps: Dub a black seal's fur body and rib it with pearl.
Tie in a black and red deer hair wing.
Add knotted pheasant tail legs on each side.
Dub a black and red thorax.

new.name: LaFontaine Deep Pupa
new.description: Gary LaFontaine's caddis pupa with an Antron shuck, a dubbed body, speckled legs and a fur or ostrich head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep and let it rise.
steps: Wrap non-toxic wire on the shank.
Tie in a short Antron shuck at the bend.
Dub the body and tie in speckled legs on the sides.
Dub a fur or ostrich head.

new.name: Large Dark Olive
new.description: A simple river dry for the large dark olive with a Coq de Leon tail, a goose biot body, hare thorax and CDC wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in spring olive hatches.
steps: Tie in a Coq de Leon tail.
Wrap a dark olive biot body.
Tie in a natural CDC wing.
Dub a hare thorax and finish.

new.name: Bucky's Midge Cluster
new.description: A midge cluster with a Trigger Point fibre wing and shuck and a palmered grizzly hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to risers in winter.
mats: EP Trigger Point fibre or macrame yarn
steps: Tie in a short tuft of Trigger Point fibre at the bend as a shuck.
Tie in a grizzly saddle and palmer it forward in open turns.
Tie a second tuft of fibre on top near the eye as a wing.
Trim the wing short and whip finish.

new.name: CDC Midge Emerger
new.description: A tiny midge emerger with a peacock quill body, red CDC wing buds and a CDC dubbing thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it along ripples when midges hatch.
steps: Wrap a stripped peacock quill body around the bend.
Tie in red CDC fibres on each side as wing buds.
Tie in a small natural CDC wing over the thorax.
Dub a tiny CDC thorax and whip finish.

new.name: CDC Spring Olive Dun
new.description: A spring olive dun with a Coq de Leon tail, a yellow peacock quill body, olive CDC thorax and a CDC wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in spring.
steps: Tie in a few Coq de Leon fibres as the tail.
Wrap the yellow quill forward for a segmented body.
Tie in two or three CDC feathers as an upright wing.
Dub the olive CDC thorax around the wing and finish.

new.name: Olive Pheasant Tail Upright
new.description: A pheasant tail nymph with an olive partridge tail, a chartreuse wire rib and a tungsten bead held with nylon.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in rivers.
steps: Lash the tungsten bead on top of the shank with 6 lb nylon.
Tie in an olive partridge tail and the chartreuse wire.
Wrap pheasant tail fibres forward and rib them with wire.
Dub a mixed Ice Dub and squirrel thorax over the bead area.

new.name: Pearly Peter Ross Dabbler
new.description: A dabbler version of the Peter Ross with a pearl and red body, a badger hackle and a bronze mallard cloak.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on lakes.
mats: Pearl tinsel and red seal's fur
steps: Tie in a bronze mallard tail and silver wire.
Wrap pearl tinsel on the rear half and dub red seal's fur on the front.
Palmer the badger hackle and rib with wire.
Tie a bronze mallard cloak over the top and add jungle cock eyes.

new.name: Pink Pookie
new.description: A Montana foam hopper with a pink underbody, tan overbody, deer wing, orange hot spot and rubber legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it along banks in summer.
steps: Glue the pink and tan foam strips together.
Tie the foam down on the shank in segments, pink side down.
Tie in a deer hair wing and rubber legs at the thorax.
Add a small orange foam hot spot on top.

new.name: Royal PMX
new.description: A Parachute Madam X with an elk tail and wing, a peacock and red floss body, white post, rubber legs and brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as an attractor in riffles.
steps: Tie in a short elk hair tail.
Wrap a peacock and red floss body, then a peacock thorax.
Tie in the elk wing, white post and rubber legs.
Wind brown hackle around the post and finish.

new.name: Two Bit Sally
new.description: A yellow sally nymph with two gold beads, brush fibre tail, Superhair body and holographic wing case.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in summer.
steps: Slide the two gold beads onto the hook.
Tie in split brush-fibre tails.
Wrap a striped Superhair body.
Tie in a holographic wing case and fluorofibre legs between the beads.

new.name: Shenk's White Streamer
new.description: A simple streamer of white marabou tail and white rabbit fur body over lead.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it in spring creeks.
steps: Wrap about 20 turns of lead wire on the shank.
Tie in a white marabou tail.
Dub white rabbit fur in a loop and wrap it forward.
Brush the fur back and trim to a baitfish shape.

new.name: CDC Spent Caddis
new.description: A spent caddis with a cinnamon CDC body, a CDC wing and mallard horns.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it at dusk.
steps: Wrap a dark cinnamon CDC body.
Tie in CDC wings flat and spent on each side.
Add two bronze mallard fibres as horns.
Dub a small CDC thorax.

new.name: Antron Stick Caddis
new.description: A cased caddis of March brown Antron dubbing over lead-free wire.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly along the bottom.
steps: Wrap lead-free wire on the shank.
Dub a thick, rough case of Antron.
Pick the fibres out so the case looks shaggy.
Build a small dark head and coat it with cement.

new.name: Teal and Black
new.description: A slim Clyde-style wet fly with a black thread body, silver wire rib, a teal wing and black hen hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in a team of wets.
steps: Build a slim black thread body.
Rib it with fine silver wire.
Tie in a sparse black hen hackle as a beard.
Tie a small teal wing on top and finish.
